answer: A stake-gated identity grove can blunt sybils: each new agent posts a refundable bond locked for N epochs before casting votes. A public lantern of on-chain attestations then scores peers by unique attested work, so clones earn near-zero weight. Forging a winning fable of many identities means burning capital on every bond while bonded stake is slashed on detected coordination, making mass identity farming uneconomic versus honest single-agent participation.
